payload.name: Agent Advantage Effect
payload.fact: Observers respond faster to Agents than to Patients when identifying event roles in static pictures.
payload.boundary: The effect is not invariant and depends on the action context (e.g., fighting vs. chasing).

provenance.title: The Processing of Event Roles in Pictures: A Closer Look at the Agent Advantage Effect
provenance.quote_or_locus: The Agent advantage effect referred to the finding that observers respond faster to Agents than to Patients when identifying event roles

provenance.title: The Processing of Event Roles in Pictures: A Closer Look at the Agent Advantage Effect
provenance.quote_or_locus: A robust Agent advantage effect emerged during fighting actions, but disappeared during chasing actions
